snippet.title: Dark Light: Survivor Early Access launching trailer
snippet.description:
Dark Light: Survivor Now Available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3088070/Dark_Light_Survivor/

A roguelike survival game set in a post-apocalyptic multiverse, where you can instantly swap between third-person and top-down views.

Each hero brings a different way to fight, from brutal melee strength to fast ranged gunplay and destructive elemental power. Survive the darkness and carve your path through the void.

Music by Zelig Sound

#DarkLightSurvivor #Roguelike #IndieGame #ActionRPG #SteamGames #vampiresurvivors
